User: I joined a yoga retreat with my friend Emma last weekend, and it was a rejuvenating experience practicing in such a serene environment.
Assistant: That sounds lovely — glad you had a rejuvenating time. Would you like to send a quick note to Emma to say thanks or share photos? I can draft and send it or save it as a draft.

Here are two short options you can use. Tell me which one you prefer (and whether to send or save as draft), or give any edits.

Option A — Casual & warm
Subject: Loved the retreat!
Body: Hey Emma — I had such a wonderful time at the yoga retreat with you last weekend. The setting was so peaceful and it felt great to unplug and practice together. Thank you for being such a lovely retreat buddy — we should plan another getaway soon! xo

Option B — Short & grateful (more neutral)
Subject: Thank you
Body: Hi Emma — thank you for joining me at the yoga retreat last weekend. It was a really peaceful, rejuvenating experience and I appreciated practicing together. Would you be interested in planning another day like that sometime?

If you want, I can:
- Send one now (I’ll find Emma’s email in your inbox if you don’t give it), or
- Save it as a draft, or
- Edit the tone/length or add photos/links.

What would you like me to do?
